Questions 21 and 22

Choose TWO letters, A-E.

Which TWO benefits of city bike-sharing schemes do the students agree are the most important?

Questions 23 and 24

Choose TWO letters, A-E.

Which TWO things do the students think are necessary for successful bike-sharing schemes?

Questions 25–30

What is the speakers’ opinion of the bike-sharing schemes in each of the following cities?

Choose SIX answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-G, next to Questions 25-30.

25 Amsterdam

26 Dublin

27 London

28 Buenos Aires

29 New York

30 Sydney

Opinion of bike-sharing scheme
A They agree it has been disappointing.
B They think it should be cheaper.
C They are surprised it has been so successful.
D They agree that more investment is required.
E They think the system has been well designed.
F They disagree about the reasons for its success.
G They think it has expanded too quickly.

transcript.en: Now that we've done all the research into bike-sharing schemes in cities around the world,
transcript.zh: 既然我们已经完成了对世界各地城市自行车共享计划的所有研究

transcript.en: we need to think about how we're going to organise our report.
transcript.zh: 我们需要考虑如何组织报告结构。

transcript.en: Right.I think we should start by talking about the benefits.
transcript.zh: 没错。我觉得还是先说说优势吧。

transcript.en: I mean it's great that so many cities have introduced these schemes where anyone can pick up a bike from dozens of different locations and hire it for a few hours.
transcript.zh: 我的意思是，这么多的城市已经推出了共享单车计划，任何人都可以从不同的位置地点获得单车，可以租用几个小时，这很好。

transcript.en: It makes riding a bike very convenient for people.
transcript.zh: 它使得骑自行车对人们来说非常方便。

transcript.en: Yes, but the costs can add up and that puts people on low incomes off in some places.
transcript.zh: 是的，但是费用也会增加，这使得一些地方的低收入人群知难而退。

transcript.en: I suppose so, but if it means more people in general are cycling rather than driving, then because they're increasing the amount of physical activity they do,it's good for their health.
transcript.zh: 的却如此，但是如果这能使更多的人放弃开车而选择骑自行车,会对他们的健康有好处，因为这增加了他们的体育活动量。

transcript.en: OK. But isn't that of less importance? I mean, doesn't the impact of reduced emissions on air pollution have a more significant effect on people's health?
transcript.zh: 是的。但这个理由不是最主要的吧？我的意思是，把因排放而造成的空气污染降低难道不会对人们的健康影响更显著吗？

transcript.en: Certainly, in some cities bike-sharing has made a big contribution to that.
transcript.zh: 是的，在某些城市，共享单车对此做出了很大贡献。

transcript.en: And also helped to cut the number of cars on the road significantly. Which is the main point.
transcript.zh: 并且也明显有助于减少公路上上的汽车交通数量。这才是重点。

transcript.en: Exactly.But I'd say it's had less of an impact on noise pollution because there are still loads of buses and lorries around. Right.
transcript.zh: 没错。但我想说，它对噪音污染的影响较小，因为周围仍然有大量的公共汽车和卡车。是的。

transcript.en: Shall we quickly discuss the recommendations we're going to make?
transcript.zh: 我们能快速讨论一下我们将要提出的建议吗？

transcript.en: In order to ensure bike-sharing schemes are successful? Yes.
transcript.zh: 为了确保自行车共享计划的成功？是的

transcript.en: OK. Well, while I think it's nice to have really state-of-the art bikes with things like GPS, I wouldn't say they're absolutely necessary.
transcript.zh: 好的。嗯，虽然我认为配备定位系统的先进的自行车很好，但我并不觉得它们是绝对必要的。

transcript.en: But some technical things are really important - like a fully functional app -so people can make payments and book bikes easily.
transcript.zh: 但是某些技术层面的东西真的很重要——比如一个功能齐全的应用程序——这样人们就可以很容易地进行支付和预订单车。

transcript.en: Places which haven't invested in that have really struggled.
transcript.zh: 那些没投资过这些技术手段的区域一直在纠结挣扎。

transcript.en: Good point... Some people say there shouldn't be competing companies offering separate bike-sharing schemes,
transcript.zh: 这个观点很好。有人说，不应该有相互竞争的公司提供不同的共享单车计划

transcript.en: but in some really big cities, competition's beneficial and anyway one company might not be able to manage the whole thing.
transcript.zh: 但在一些真正的大城市，竞争是有益的，无论如何，一家公司可能无法管理整个事情。

transcript.en: Right. Deciding how much to invest is a big question.
transcript.zh: 没错。决定投资金额多少是个大问题。

transcript.en: Cities which have opened loads of new bike lanes at the same time as introducing bike-sharing schemes have generally been more successful-
transcript.zh: 那些在引入共享单车计划的同时也开辟了大量新自行车道的城市通常更加成功

transcript.en: but there are examples of successful schemes where this hasn't happened ... What does matter though - is having a big publicity campaign.
transcript.zh: 但是有一些成功的例子显示以上的这种情况并没有发生...，真正重要的是进行大规模的宣传活动。

transcript.en: Definitely. If people don't know how to use the scheme or don't understand its benefits, they won't use it.
transcript.zh: 的确如此。如果人们不知道如何使用这个方案，或者不了解它的好处，大家就不会使用它。

transcript.en: People need a lot of persuasion to stop using their cars.
transcript.zh: 人们需要很多劝解才能停止使用汽车。

transcript.en: Shall we look at some examples now? And say what we think is good or bad about them.
transcript.zh: 我们现在来看一些例子好吗？同时说出我们对他们的看法。

transcript.en: I suppose we should start with Amsterdam as this was one of the first cities to have a bike-sharing scheme.
transcript.zh: 我想我们应该从阿姆斯特丹说起，因为这是第一批实行共享单车计划的城市之一。

transcript.en: Yes. There was already a strong culture of cycling here.
transcript.zh: 是的。这里已经有了浓厚的自行车文化。

transcript.en: In a way it's strange that there was such a demand for bike-sharing because you'd have thought most people would have used their own bikes.
transcript.zh: 从某种程度上来说，很奇怪为什么会有对共享单车的需求，因为你会认为大多数人会使用自己的自行车。

transcript.en: And yet it's one of the best-used schemes ... Dublin's an interesting example of a success story.
transcript.zh: 然而，阿姆斯特丹项目是被利用最好的的方案之一...都柏林是取得大获成功的共享计划的有趣案例。

transcript.en: It must be because the public transport system's quite limited.
transcript.zh: 一定是当地公共交通系统很有限的原因。

transcript.en: Not really - there's no underground, but there are trams and a good bus network.
transcript.zh: 并不是这样-没有地铁，但是有电车和良好的公交网络。

transcript.en: I'd say price has a lot to do with it.It's one of the cheapest schemes in Europe to join.
transcript.zh: 我得说价格和它的成功有很大关系。这是欧洲最便宜的计划之一。

transcript.en: But the buses are really slow - anyway the weather certainly can't be a factor!
transcript.zh: 但是公共汽车真的很慢——不管怎样，肯定不是天气状况的原因！

transcript.en: No - definitely not. The London scheme's been quite successful.
transcript.zh: 是的-绝对不是这个原因。伦敦的计划相当成功。

transcript.en: Yes, it's been a really good thing for the city.
transcript.zh: 是的——对这个城市来说真是件好事。

transcript.en: The bikes are popular and the whole system is well maintained but it isn't expanding quickly enough.
transcript.zh: 自行车很受欢迎，整个系统维护得很好，但扩展速度不够快。

transcript.en: Basically, not enough's been spent on increasing the number of cycle lanes.
transcript.zh: 总的来说，在增加自行车道数量上投入的钱还不够多。

transcript.en: Hopefully that'll change.
transcript.zh: 希望这一点会得到改善。

transcript.en: Yes. Now what about outside Europe?
transcript.zh: 对。那么欧洲以外的其它地区情况怎样呢？

transcript.en: Well bike-sharing schemes have taken off in places like Buenos Aires.
transcript.zh: 共享单车计划在布宜诺斯艾利斯等地已经开始实施。

transcript.en: Mmm.They built a huge network of cycle lanes to support the introduction of the scheme there, didn't they?
transcript.zh: 嗯。他们建立了一个庞大的自行车道网络系统，以支持该计划的实施，不是吗？

transcript.en: It attracted huge numbers of cyclists where previously there were hardly any.
transcript.zh: 这吸引了大量的骑自行车的人，是前所未有的。

transcript.en: An example of good planning.
transcript.zh: 一个精心设计规划的典型案例。

transcript.en: Absolutely. New York is a good example of how not to introduce a scheme.
transcript.zh: 的确如此。纽约是一个典型的引入计划失败的案例。

transcript.en: When they launched it, it was more than ten times the price of most other schemes.
transcript.zh: 当他们推出这项计划时，制定的价格是大多数其他计划的十倍多。

transcript.en: More than it costs to take a taxi. Crazy.I think the organisers lacked vision and ambition there.
transcript.zh: 比坐出租车还贵。这太疯狂了。我认为组织者缺乏远见和抱负。

transcript.en: I think so too.
transcript.zh: 我也这么认为。

transcript.en: Sydney would be a good example to use. I would have expected it to have grown pretty quickly here.
transcript.zh: 悉尼将会是一个很好的例子。我原本以为共享计划在这里会发展得很快。

transcript.en: Yes. I can't quite work out why it hasn't been an instant success like some of the others. It's a shame really.
transcript.zh: 是的。我不太明白为什么悉尼没有像其他一些项目那样迅速成功，真的很遗憾。

transcript.en: I know. OK so now we've thought about...
transcript.zh: 我知道。好了，现在我们考虑了...
